messages:
Maria: Kicking off paid setup for the EarlyBird holiday push. Attached is a lightweight plan — search + retarget combo. Need quick alignment on budget pacing and creative rotation. https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1A2bC3d4e5F
Aj: On it. Can we prioritize high-intent search terms first thing morning and then open retargets after 48h? Want to avoid early churn. :eyes:
Tom: Agree on 48h window. For retargeting creative we should run 2 refreshes: static carousel and a short testimonial video (6s). Rotation every 72h.
Kelly: Budget ask: $6k/day start for first 3 days, then assess. If CPA < target, scale 20% every 48h. Is that the plan?
Maria: Yes. Initial pacing: `budget_plan = {"day1":6000, "scale_step":0.2, "eval_interval_hours":48}`. Ryan, can you confirm conversion pixel is firing on the webinar LP?
Ryan: Pixel is firing but noticed duplicate events from the form webhook. Pushed a fix to the webhook mapping: `hubspot.lead.source = params.utm_source || 'paid_search'`. I'll redeploy in 10. deploy-bot: deployment started for webhook mapping (id: deploy-987).
sdr-ops: Heads-up — inbound routing: new leads from campaign should go to SDR queue 'holiday-earlybird' and notify via Slack webhook to #sales-leads. I've added mapping in HubSpot.
Aj: Quick note on keywords: prioritize "redwood inference pricing", "low latency llm inference", and negative-match competitor brand terms. Also add broad modifier for long-tail dev queries.
Tom: Creative copy iterations (A/B):
- A: "Ship LLM features with predictable latency — try EarlyBird"
- B: "Cut inference cost with model-aware serving — demo"
We'll track CTR and CVR. Use `ad_variant=A` in UTM for clarity.
Kelly: Can we set ad schedule to heavy weekdays 9-6 and light weekends? Also enable automated bid caps overnight to avoid overspend.
Maria: Yes. Scheduling and bid caps in the sheet. Link to campaign config: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1A2bC3d4e5F#gid=2
Aj: One more: enable prefix caching mention in copy for engineers? Might be too product-y. Maybe test in Variant B-2 for a technical audience.
Ryan: FYI—GA4 is recording sessions but not attributing correctly until webhook fix deploys. Hold detailed reporting until deploy is green.
Tom: Retargeting audience: 7d site visitors for video, 14d for brochure download. Exclude converters.
Maria: Great. Assigning action items: Aj (keyword list + negative terms), Tom (creative assets + sizing), Kelly (ad schedule + budget automation), Ryan (deploy webhook fix + confirm pixel), sdr-ops (routing + Slack alert). Check-ins at +24h and +72h.
Kelly: +1. I'll set a 24h standup thread and ping the group. :calendar:
Maria: Thanks team. If webhook deploy takes longer we hold retarget ramp by 12-24h so leads map correctly.
deploy-bot: deployment succeeded for webhook mapping (id: deploy-987) — 1735554405
Ryan: Deployed and verified. Conversion dedupe fixed. Ready to ramp when marketing gives green.
Aj: Starting keyword uploads now. Will share the first tranche in the sheet in ~20m.
Maria: Green light to start search on low-risk keywords only. Hold full spend until metrics look stable.
Kelly: Noted. Turning on pacing caps. I'll post the live spend dashboard link in the 24h thread.
Maria: Perfect — end of thread for now.
